item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "05242e3d07a99a74f871ec59a1133d6d5e78150fa403cfa7812863e9503011f2",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "The grid structure described by constructor D005: a domain and a nonempty indexed family of measurable, pairwise disjoint regions whose union is the domain.",
      "effect_on_target": "Restricts the quantified grid to such partitions; the index type is not required to be finite or countable.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "Projects the grid's second field, its function assigning a set of points to each cell.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specifies the region used in every cellwise measure, integrability, equality, and average.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "For a measure μ, region R, field f, and value a, asserts μ(R) ≠ 0, μ(R) ≠ ∞, integrability of f on R, and a = LocalDef004 μ R f, all conjunctively.",
      "effect_on_target": "The assigned values must equal the defined normalized integrals, with positive finite measure and integrability included in the certification predicate. Uniqueness concerns assignments satisfying this entire predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "The real scalar (μ(R).toReal)⁻¹ acting on MeasureTheory.integral (μ.restrict R) f.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines the averaging operation used in certification, locality, and reproduction of constants. For positive finite measure the scalar is the reciprocal of the real region measure; the integral's implementation is opaque in D047.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "LocalDef005",
      "meaning": "Constructs a grid from a domain Ω, a family R indexed by Cell, a proof that Cell is nonempty, measurability of every R(c), disjointness of R(c₁) and R(c₂) for distinct indices, and the equivalence x ∈ Ω iff there exists c with x ∈ R(c).",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the structural restrictions implicit in grid: measurable regions partition the domain and there is at least one cell.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires all four main conclusions simultaneously and all four clauses of each certification predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "CompleteSpace",
      "meaning": "Completeness of a uniform space: every Cauchy filter converges.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires Parameter to be complete for the uniform structure induced by its norm, making it a real Banach space with the other instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "DFunLike.coe",
      "meaning": "Extracts the function represented by a function-like object.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes application of the measure to a region an ENNReal-valued function evaluation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "ENNReal",
      "meaning": "Nonnegative real numbers with an added top element, representing infinity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Region measures lie in [0, ∞]; excluding zero and top means strictly positive finite measure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses exact equality of parameter values and of whole assignment functions, not equality modulo null sets.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over an object satisfying a predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "Produces one function assigned : Cell → Parameter satisfying every subsequent conjunct for the fixed initial data.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "MeasurableSpace",
      "meaning": "A sigma-algebra of measurable subsets of a type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Equips Point with the measurable structure used by the grid and measure; no topology on Point is required.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn",
      "meaning": "Integrability of f with respect to the restricted measure μ.restrict R.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires cellwise integrability, conventionally almost everywhere strong measurability and finite integral of the norm in the Banach-valued setting; it imposes no global integrability requirement.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.Measure",
      "meaning": "A nonnegative, extended-real-valued measure on a measurable space.",
      "effect_on_target": "physicalVolume is an arbitrary measure on Point; its name does not impose a particular geometric or physical measure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike",
      "meaning": "Evaluates a measure on sets through its underlying outer measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets physicalVolume applied to a cell region as the measure of that region.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Ne",
      "meaning": "Negation of equality.",
      "effect_on_target": "Excludes zero and infinite region measure and distinguishes indices in the grid's disjointness condition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "An additive commutative group with a norm and its compatible metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides Parameter's vector addition, zero, norm, and metric; together with the real normed-space and completeness assumptions it supports Banach-valued integration.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive group, and induced pseudometric while viewing a normed group as a seminormed group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies inherited structures for Parameter without adding hypotheses or altering its norm.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "NormedSpace",
      "meaning": "A vector space over a normed field whose scalar action is compatible with the norms.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes Parameter a real normed vector space and gives meaning to multiplying the integral by a reciprocal real measure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number numeral through the selected instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets the numeral 0 in the measure hypotheses as ENNReal zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Projects the uniform structure of a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures completeness and the induced topology refer to the uniform structure associated with Parameter's norm.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The real-number scalar type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the scalar field and the type of the normalization factor to the real numbers.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The real field with its usual normed-field structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real scalar field used by the normed-space instance, consistently with real addition, multiplication, and inversion.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Projects the pseudometric structure of a seminormed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Links Parameter's topology and uniformity to the metric coming from its norm.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "SeminormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Forgets commutativity while retaining the additive group, norm, and pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an inherited structure needed for the extended norm used in integrability; adds no restriction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "SeminormedAddGroup.toContinuousENorm",
      "meaning": "Equips a seminormed group with the continuous extended nonnegative norm obtained from its nonnegative norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes integrability use Parameter's existing norm, expressed in extended nonnegative reals.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "Set",
      "meaning": "A subset of a type is a predicate on its elements.",
      "effect_on_target": "Domains and cell regions are arbitrary subsets of Point subject to the grid's stated conditions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "Set.EqOn",
      "meaning": "For every x belonging to a given set, the two functions have equal values at x.",
      "effect_on_target": "The locality conclusion assumes pointwise equality throughout the cell region, not merely almost everywhere equality.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "Top.top",
      "meaning": "Selects the designated greatest element.",
      "effect_on_target": "In ENNReal this is infinity, which each cell measure must differ from.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Projects the topology associated with a uniform structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "The topology used for integrability on Parameter is the one induced by its norm.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets the numeral zero using the type's zero element.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the literal 0 in the measure inequalities to ENNReal zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "instTopENNReal",
      "meaning": "The top element of ENNReal is the added top of WithTop.",
      "effect_on_target": "Identifies the excluded top measure with infinity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "instZeroENNReal",
      "meaning": "The zero of ENNReal is the embedded zero of its underlying nonnegative reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Identifies the excluded zero measure with ordinary zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "AddMonoid.toAddZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Extracts addition, zero, and the additive identity laws from an additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited additive-zero structure for the scalar-action instance chain; adds no mathematical condition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "AddZero.toZero",
      "meaning": "Projects the zero element from an addition-with-zero structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the same Parameter zero used by inherited scalar-action structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "AddZeroClass.toAddZero",
      "meaning": "Projects addition and zero while forgetting their identity-law proofs.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the inherited zero structure without changing any operation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication distributing over addition and preserving zero from a distributive monoid action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Carries the real module action into the scalar multiplication used in LocalDef004.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "DistribSMul.toSMulZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar action and its zero-preservation property.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the existing real scalar action along its instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "ENNReal.toReal",
      "meaning": "Converts an extended nonnegative real to a real through toNNReal and then toReal; for finite inputs this yields their real value.",
      "effect_on_target": "Converts each finite positive cell measure into the real denominator used by the averaging operation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "ENormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets norm separation while retaining the extended seminormed additive commutative monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies inherited algebraic structures associated with Parameter's norm; introduces no new restriction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative monoid from an extended seminormed additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides Parameter's inherited additive structure for its module and scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets commutativity while retaining the extended seminormed additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the inherited additive-monoid instance chain without changing the target's meaning.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Projects the underlying additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies addition and zero in the scalar-action infrastructure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "HSMul.hSMul",
      "meaning": "Applies the selected heterogeneous scalar multiplication operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Multiplies a Parameter-valued integral by a real reciprocal measure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "Inv.inv",
      "meaning": "Applies the selected inversion operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms the reciprocal of the real cell measure in LocalDef004.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict",
      "meaning": "Restricts a measure to a region, implemented by applying restrictₗ to the measure; on the measurable cell regions this is the measure A ↦ μ(A ∩ R).",
      "effect_on_target": "Both integrability and integration are taken only over the selected cell region.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.integral",
      "meaning": "A Parameter-valued integration operator taking a measure and a function, presented only as the projection MeasureTheory.wrapped✝.1. Its conventional interpretation is the Bochner integral, but the supplied body does not expose that construction or its laws.",
      "effect_on_target": "Its value determines every average. The literal formula is unambiguous, but identifying the opaque operator with the usual Bochner integral requires the standard external-frontier interpretation.",
      "status": "unclear"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Projects a module's distributive multiplicative scalar action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures the action in the average is inherited from Parameter's real vector-space structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toENormedAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Views a normed additive commutative group as an extended normed additive commutative monoid using its existing norm and addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the extended-norm and additive structures used by integration and scalar-action instances without additional assumptions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Projects the underlying module of a normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real scalar multiplication and vector-space laws for Parameter.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "Real.instInv",
      "meaning": "Selects Real.inv'✝ as the real inversion operation, consistent with the real field structure displayed in D023.",
      "effect_on_target": "Normalizes by the real reciprocal of the positive finite region measure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "Real.instMonoid",
      "meaning": "The inferred multiplicative monoid structure on the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the scalar monoid needed to inherit the real module action; adds no separate assumption.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "The inferred semiring structure on the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the scalar algebra used by the real module instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "SMulZeroClass.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Projects scalar multiplication from a scalar action that preserves zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar operation later exposed through HSMul.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "instHSMul",
      "meaning": "Uses an ordinary scalar action as a heterogeneous scalar action with the same result type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Confirms that LocalDef004 uses the existing real scalar multiplication on Parameter.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "CompleteAtomicBooleanAlgebra.toCompleteBooleanAlgebra",
      "meaning": "Forgets atomicity while retaining the complete Boolean algebra structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the inherited order structure on sets used to interpret disjointness in the grid.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "CompleteBooleanAlgebra.toCompleteDistribLattice",
      "meaning": "Extracts the complete distributive lattice structure from a complete Boolean algebra.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the usual set lattice in the order-instance chain supporting grid disjointness.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "CompleteBooleanAlgebra.toCompleteLattice",
      "meaning": "Projects the complete lattice structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the lattice of sets underlying their order and disjointness.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "CompleteDistribLattice.toFrame",
      "meaning": "Projects the frame structure from a complete distributive lattice.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports inheritance of the bottom element and order structure on sets.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "CompleteLattice.instOmegaCompletePartialOrder",
      "meaning": "Views a complete lattice as an omega-complete partial order, with a chain's supremum given by the supremum of its entries.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies an inherited partial order on sets. It does not require the cell index type to be countable.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "Disjoint",
      "meaning": "Every common lower bound of two objects is below bottom; for sets ordered by inclusion, their intersection is empty.",
      "effect_on_target": "Distinct cell regions have no point in common, a stronger condition than intersection of measure zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "HeytingAlgebra.toOrderBot",
      "meaning": "Projects the order with its least element.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the empty set as bottom in the set-disjointness condition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "Iff",
      "meaning": "Logical equivalence, requiring both implications.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires the grid domain to be exactly the union of cell regions, including both coverage and containment.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "MeasurableSet",
      "meaning": "Membership of a set in the given measurable space's sigma-algebra.",
      "effect_on_target": "Every cell region is measurable as part of the grid structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "Membership.mem",
      "meaning": "Applies the selected membership relation to a collection and an element.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses membership of points in the domain and cell regions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "Nonempty",
      "meaning": "Asserts that a type has at least one element without selecting one.",
      "effect_on_target": "The grid requires at least one cell, ruling out an empty indexing family.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "OmegaCompletePartialOrder.toPartialOrder",
      "meaning": "Projects the underlying partial order.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the subset order used in the definition of disjoint cell regions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "Order.Frame.toHeytingAlgebra",
      "meaning": "Extracts a Heyting algebra with the same lattice, top, bottom, and implication operations from a frame.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the set order and empty-set bottom used by disjointness.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "Set.instCompleteAtomicBooleanAlgebra",
      "meaning": "The complete atomic Boolean algebra of subsets, with inclusion, unions, intersections, complement, empty set, and universal set.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the abstract order-theoretic disjointness condition mean ordinary disjointness of cell regions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "Set.instMembership",
      "meaning": "The membership relation for sets, given by satisfaction of their defining predicates.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the coverage equivalence and equality-on-a-region condition ordinary pointwise statements about membership.",
      "status": "understood"
    }
  ],
  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "Universally quantify over types Cell, Point, and Parameter, with no restrictions on their universe sizes.",
      "Equip Point with a measurable space and Parameter with a complete real normed vector-space structure.",
      "Universally quantify over a grid consisting of a domain Ω and a nonempty family of measurable, pairwise disjoint regions R(c), indexed by c ∈ Cell, whose union is Ω.",
      "Universally quantify over a measure μ = physicalVolume on Point and a function f = materialParameter : Point → Parameter.",
      "After the hypotheses, existentially quantify over a single assignment a : Cell → Parameter, which may depend on the fixed structures, grid, μ, and f.",
      "Within the uniqueness conclusion universally quantify over b : Cell → Parameter; within locality universally quantify over c ∈ Cell and g : Point → Parameter; within constant reproduction universally quantify over c ∈ Cell and p ∈ Parameter."
    ],
    "hypotheses": [
      "For every cell c, μ(R(c)) ≠ 0.",
      "For every cell c, μ(R(c)) ≠ ∞. Together with the preceding hypothesis, each cell has strictly positive finite measure.",
      "For every cell c, f is integrable with respect to μ restricted to R(c)."
    ],
    "conclusions": [
      "There exists a : Cell → Parameter such that, for every c, μ(R(c)) ≠ 0, μ(R(c)) ≠ ∞, f is integrable on R(c), and a(c) = Aμ,R(c)(f).",
      "For every b : Cell → Parameter, if for every c the region has nonzero finite measure, f is integrable there, and b(c) = Aμ,R(c)(f), then b = a as functions.",
      "For every cell c and every g : Point → Parameter, if f(x) = g(x) for every x ∈ R(c), then a(c) = Aμ,R(c)(g). No separate integrability assumption on g is quantified.",
      "For every cell c and every parameter value p, Aμ,R(c)(x ↦ p) = p."
    ],
    "mathematical_definitions": [
      "Write Iν(h) for the Parameter-valued operator MeasureTheory.integral ν h. Under its conventional external-frontier interpretation, this is the Bochner integral ∫ h dν; the supplied body is opaque.",
      "Define Aμ,R(h) = ((μ(R)).toReal)⁻¹ • Iμ.restrict R(h), where • is the real scalar action on Parameter.",
      "On the measurable regions in this proposition, μ.restrict R is restriction of μ to R. Since 0 < μ(R) < ∞, the normalization factor is the reciprocal of the ordinary real measure of R.",
      "The certification predicate means positive finite region measure, integrability on that region, and equality to the specified normalized integral; it does not independently characterize an average by another property.",
      "Equality on a region means equality at every point of that region. Equality of assignments means equality of their values at every cell."
    ],
    "proposition_plain_english": "For every measurable point space, real Banach parameter space, nonempty indexed measurable partition of a domain, measure μ, and parameter field f, assume that each cell region has strictly positive finite μ-measure and that f is integrable on each region. There exists a unique assignment of parameter values to cells satisfying the certification predicate: its value at each cell is the integral of f over that cell multiplied by the reciprocal of the cell's real measure. The same assignment simultaneously has the following locality property: for each cell, any alternative field agreeing with f at every point of that cell has normalized integral equal to the assigned value there. Furthermore, averaging any globally constant parameter field over any cell returns its constant value. Here 'integral' denotes the dossier's supplied integration operator; its interpretation as the usual Bochner integral is subject to the opaque-definition ambiguity recorded below."
  },
  "restrictions_and_vacuity_risks": [
    "The grid requires a nonempty cell type, measurable cell regions, exact pairwise disjointness, and exact coverage of its domain. It does not merely require disjointness or coverage up to null sets.",
    "Positive measure excludes empty and null cell regions. Together with the nonempty cell type, it forces the domain and point type to be nonempty whenever the hypotheses are satisfied.",
    "For initial data with a null or infinite-measure cell, or a cell on which f is not integrable, the implication makes no substantive assertion.",
    "No finiteness or countability of the cell family is assumed. No finite total domain measure, sigma-finiteness of μ, global integrability of f, or measurability of the entire domain is explicitly required.",
    "Parameter may be any real Banach space, including the zero space; there is no finite-dimensionality, order, positivity, or nontriviality assumption on it.",
    "Point has no required topology or geometry. The names grid, physicalVolume, and materialParameter encode no geometric shape, physical units, constitutive law, or distinguished volume measure.",
    "The assignment is a function on cell indices. No reconstructed function on points, approximation error, convergence, conservation theorem, or relation between different grids is asserted.",
    "Locality requires pointwise agreement on a cell, not merely almost everywhere agreement. Values of the alternative field outside that cell are unrestricted.",
    "The assignment is chosen before the alternative fields and constant values are quantified, so a single assignment satisfies all the locality assertions.",
    "Constant reproduction concerns the averaging operator applied to a constant field; it does not assert that the assignment for the original arbitrary field equals every parameter value.",
    "Uniqueness is uniqueness among functions satisfying the explicit certification predicate. Since that predicate includes equality to the defined average, this is not an independent variational or physical characterization of the values."
  ],
